evidence: The morphology, distribution, and crystal structure of the Ir NCs on ALD-grown Al2O3-coated TEM grids were observed using a transmission electron microscope (TEM, FEI Tecnai G 2 F20 S-Twin, USA) operating at 200 kV. In order to characterize the chemical components of the NCs, the samples were analyzed by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS, Thermo Fisher K-Alpha, USA) with a monochromatic Al K a source (hν = 1486.6 eV) for excitation of photoelectrons at a takeoff angle of 90°.
